calls.statement:
WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) n, min(sale_date) mind, max(sale_date) maxd, min(sale_ts_utc) mints FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM o) orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) with_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id WHERE l.n<>o.line_count) linecount_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM stg_web_order_load)) in_stg,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o)) dup_check,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id WHERE l.mind<>CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) date_diff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date=DATE '2025-11-28') sl_wb_lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date=DATE '2025-11-28') sl_wb_orders,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') sl_wb_orders_utc
